text: A 24-year-old man with recurrent pulmonary infections and a groin abscess. S. aureus on culture. NBT test: no blue pigment in neutrophils.
objective: CGD — NADPH oxidase deficiency. Can't generate respiratory burst. NBT test is diagnostic.

text: A 55-year-old alcoholic: confusion, ophthalmoplegia, ataxia. IV glucose given without vitamin supplementation worsens symptoms.
objective: Wernicke encephalopathy. Always thiamine BEFORE glucose.

text: A 32-year-old woman: diplopia and ptosis worsening throughout the day. Anterior mediastinal mass on CT. Improves with edrophonium.
objective: Myasthenia gravis — anti-AChR antibodies. Associated with thymoma.

text: A 67-year-old smoker with a central lung mass. Biopsy: intercellular bridges, keratin pearls.
objective: SCC of lung — central, keratin pearls, intercellular bridges.

text: A 19-year-old post-MVC. BP 80/50, HR 130, JVD, muffled heart sounds. Low-voltage QRS on ECG.
objective: Cardiac tamponade — Beck's triad + equalization of diastolic pressures.

text: A 4-year-old boy: calf pseudohypertrophy, Gowers sign, no dystrophin on biopsy.
objective: Duchenne MD — X-linked recessive. Dystrophin gene on Xp21.

text: A 22-year-old woman with recurrent DVTs. Family hx of VTE. Activated protein C resistance on testing.
objective: Factor V Leiden — most common inherited thrombophilia.

text: A 65-year-old man: resting tremor, cogwheel rigidity, bradykinesia. Unilateral onset, progressive.
objective: Parkinson disease — dopaminergic neurons in SNpc.

text: A 58-year-old man: 'worst headache of his life.' CT negative. LP: xanthochromia.
objective: SAH — CT-negative, LP-positive → CTA to find the aneurysm.

text: A 50-year-old man: sudden tearing chest pain to back. BP 190/110 R arm, 150/90 L arm. Widened mediastinum.
objective: Aortic dissection — CTA chest for diagnosis.

text: A 75-year-old woman: acute right-sided weakness, slurred speech, onset 2 hours ago. CT negative. NIHSS 14.
objective: Acute ischemic stroke in window → IV tPA.

text: A 28-year-old woman at 34 weeks: severe headache, BP 170/110, 3+ proteinuria, platelets 90K, ↑LFTs.
objective: Severe preeclampsia/HELLP. MgSO₄ + steroids for fetal lungs + deliver.

text: A 48-year-old man: crushing chest pain × 2h. ST elevation in II, III, aVF. Cath lab 30 min away.
objective: STEMI — if PCI within 120 min of FMC, transfer for primary PCI.

text: A 6-month-old: irritability, vomiting, bulging fontanelle. X-rays show fractures at different healing stages.
objective: Non-accidental trauma — mandatory CPS reporting + skeletal survey.

text: A 78-year-old hospitalized woman: acutely confused, agitated, visual hallucinations. Fluctuating course.
objective: Delirium — find and treat the cause. Avoid benzos in elderly.

text: A 50-year-old man: sudden epigastric pain. Board-like abdomen. Free air on upright CXR.
objective: Pneumoperitoneum = perforated viscus → emergent surgical exploration.
